newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market at $66, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market at $66, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet early, active late, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher.
Inquiry and demand light early, inquiry good late, demand fairly good. Sales confirmed on 8,900 slaughter steers and 6,600 slaughter heifers Tuesday.
For the week to date 22,300 head confirmed, including 8,300 head or about 37 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1260 lbs 66.00, pen 1400 lbs 66.00, few early 65.00; couple pens Select with end Choice 65.25- 65.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Wk to date - 22,300 last week - 46,800 last year - 55,500
